title: Lots Of MI
description: A ModPack focused on the Modern Industrialization Mod.
body:
In this ModPack, you will imerse yourself in a world of technology,\
without changing the blocky and fun style of Minecraft.

Create boilers, electricity,\
and progress yourself through the steam age,\
along with the electric age.

You'll surely want to download this ModPack because it offers:
- Fun Gameplay
- Long, but not boring progression system
- And much more!

Features:

1. Total AUTOMATION
2. Powerfull automation systems
3. Cool progression system
4. **Overclocking**
5. Machines! (And lots of 'em)
6. Power genaration
7. Tools!

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
